description: Defines message IDs and diagnostic message methods for MigraDoc PDF rendering, specifically related to PDF message handling and error reporting.

classes.name: MdPdfMsgId
classes.description: Enumeration of message IDs used for PDF rendering diagnostics in MigraDoc.

classes.name: MdPdfMsgs
classes.description: Static class providing methods to generate diagnostic messages related to PDF rendering errors and states.

methods.name: NumberTooLargeForRoman
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a number is too large to display as a Roman numeral.

methods.name: NumberTooLargeForLetters
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a number is too large to display as letters.

methods.name: DisplayEmptyImageSize
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image has an empty size.

methods.name: DisplayImageFileNotFound
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image file was not found.

methods.name: DisplayInvalidImageType
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image has an invalid type.

methods.name: DisplayImageNotRead
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image could not be read.

methods.name: PropertyNotSetBefore
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a property must be set before a specific function call.

methods.name: BookmarkNotDefined
methods.description: Creates a message indicating a bookmark is not defined.

methods.name: ImageNotFound
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image was not found.

methods.name: InvalidImageType
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image has an invalid type.

methods.name: ImageNotReadable
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image could not be read, including inner exception details.

methods.name: EmptyImageSize
methods.description: Creates a message indicating an image size is empty.

methods.name: ObjectNotRenderable
methods.description: Creates a message indicating only certain objects can be rendered.
